entities.name: ATP synthase subunit delta
observations: The 177-aa query sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt B1KQ37 from Shewanella woodyi.
Annotated as a peripheral-stalk component of F-type ATP synthase linking F0 and F1; may transmit conformational changes or contribute to proton conduction.
Pfam OSCP domain (PF00213.24) detected at residues 7–175.
Sequence-derived properties: 19,253.8 Da; theoretical pI 4.84; predicted charge at pH 7 approximately −8.30.
